title: The Kitchen Timer
transcript: I used to burn dinner whenever I tried to cook and answer messages at the same time. My brother gave me a small kitchen timer for my birthday, and I thought it was a strange gift. But it was easier to set than my phone, and its loud bell made it hard to ignore. I now set it even when boiling eggs. Last week I bought the same timer for my brother, who has just moved into his own flat.

questions.prompt: Why did the speaker often burn dinner?
options: The speaker used the wrong pan.
The speaker was distracted by messages.
There was too little time to shop.
questions.answer: The speaker was distracted by messages.
questions.explanation: 一边做饭一边回复消息，注意力被消息分散。

questions.prompt: What made the timer difficult to overlook?
questions.explanation: 提示声响，因而很难忽视。
